annotations.title: Has this launch lifted the brand it came from?

description: Use when the user asks whether a line extension, spin-off, sequel, collaboration or new product lifted interest in the parent brand or show, or is weighing a launch on the promise of a halo. Returns, for the launch month, the parent's US search change against the three months before, the best same-window change in every other year since 2019 as a seasonal control, and a verdict against a +20% bar set before the pull: lifted, seasonal, or no lift; optionally English Wikipedia as a second signal. Ratios only. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body, and credit_name to be credited; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first, and a published piece earns one free run.

article.description: Optional: the English Wikipedia article on the parent, e.g. "Power (TV series)".

launch.description: The launch or premiere month, YYYY-MM, 2020-04 or later and finished.

parent.description: The parent brand or show as people search for it, e.g. "power" or "oreo".
